# Bitcoin Easy Signer

> Bitcoin Easy Signer is a free, open-source Mac application that helps a trusted person make a payment from an existing supported Bitcoin multisig wallet using one BSMS definition file and the required hardware signers.

The app does not create wallets, hold private keys, or recover seed words. It checks the public wallet identity and funding, prepares a payment, requests signatures on hardware devices, verifies the signed transaction, and requires final review and explicit confirmation before broadcast. It supports native SegWit multisig wallets with two or three total keys; the signing threshold comes from the wallet file. It is intended for spouses, trustees, lawyers, accountants, and other helpers who need to move Bitcoin without having set up the wallet.

- [Current release](https://github.com/cjtsh/bitcoin-easy-multisig-signer/releases/latest): Signed Mac download and release files.
- [Source and release history](https://github.com/cjtsh/bitcoin-easy-multisig-signer): Public source, version evidence, and documentation.
